name: winscript
description: AppleScript for Windows. Control any Windows app from Claude — open apps, click buttons, automate Excel/Outlook, manage files, take screenshots.
long_description:
WinScript is a state-aware, replayable, audited Windows automation server for AI agents. It wraps 4 fragmented Windows automation primitives — UI Automation, COM, Win32, and OCR — into a single MCP server that any agent can call.

**What Claude can do with WinScript:**

- **Open and control any Windows app** — Notepad, Chrome, Excel, Outlook, etc.
- **Click buttons and type text** in any UI via 5-layer element detection
- **Automate Excel** — read/write cells, ranges, save files via COM
- **Send and read Outlook emails** — full COM automation
- **Take screenshots** — Claude sees your screen
- **Manage files** — read, write, move, copy, delete
- **Record and replay workflows** — automate complex multi-step sequences
- **Semantic intents** — high-level actions like "open latest Excel file"
- **Full audit logging** — every action tracked and searchable

**59 tools across 15 categories.** Not a wrapper. Not a toy. Infrastructure.
